narr: Monsoon moisture returning to northern Arizona caused thunderstorms to develop over the Prescott area. A storm dropped enough rain to cause a flash flood on Lynx Creek.
ev: A trained spotter reported that Lynx Creek in Walker was running four to five feet deep in spots.
lsr: TRAINED SPOTTER REPORTED LYNX CREEK IN WALKER WAS RUNNING 4-5 FT DEEP IN SPOTS.
